constraint: Video clips + audio only. No third-party APIs, cloud services or pretrained models; model trained from scratch.

clip_format.audio: mono WAV, 16 kHz, 16-bit (extracted from same clip, time-aligned)
clip_format.clip_length: 2-6 s sliding windows (50% overlap) cut from labelled step segments
clip_format.fixed_camera: same side-on angle as sample video; also record 2 more angles for robustness

video: colour histograms (gloves, drape green, yellow fluid, orange catheter)
downsampled grayscale 64x64 frames for a small 3D-CNN/CNN-LSTM
audio: log-mel spectrogram or MFCC computed with FFT
short-time energy for voice activity (speech vs silence)
spectral flux for impulse sounds (clicks, tears, squeezes)

model_outputs.per_session: ordered step list, missed steps, wrong order, step durations
model_outputs.scoring: all 13 present+correct = P; one step corrected after prompt = P-1; else R

steps.label: introduce_explain
steps.expected_speech: Hello, I am Dr ___. I will be inserting a urinary catheter to drain your bladder. It may be slightly uncomfortable.

steps.label: informed_consent
steps.expected_speech: Do you understand? May I proceed? / Do I have your permission?

steps.label: hand_hygiene_gloves
steps.expected_sounds: sanitiser spray/pump, glove-box paper tear, glove snap
steps.video_motion_signature: hands rub together then glove donning

steps.label: privacy_position_exposure
steps.expected_speech: 'I am closing the screen / please lie flat'
steps.video_motion_signature: arm sweep pulling screen, patient positioning

steps.label: painting_draping
steps.expected_sounds: cotton/forceps tap on tray, drape unfold rustle
steps.video_motion_signature: repeated outward swab strokes, then drape spread

steps.label: lignocaine_jelly
steps.expected_speech: 'Applying jelly, will wait for it to act'
steps.video_motion_signature: hand squeezing tube at meatus, then stillness (wait)

steps.label: open_catheter_insert
steps.video_motion_signature: catheter pulled from pack, slow linear insertion

steps.label: attach_urobag_confirm_urine
steps.video_motion_signature: hand connects tube, yellow fluid motion in tube

steps.label: inflate_balloon
steps.video_motion_signature: syringe at side port, small plunger motion

steps.label: reposition_prepuce
steps.video_motion_signature: small forward fold motion at glans

error_clip_recipes: Skip a step entirely (session missing step N)
Swap order: inflate balloon before urine seen (step 10 before 9)
